title: Parasites' Delight
description: A terrifying culinary addon that brings the horrors of Scape and Run: Parasites to your kitchen.
body:
Parasites' Delights is an add-on mod for Farmer's Delight Legacy and Scape and Run: Parasites that integrates cooking and farming mechanics with Scape and Run: Parasites.

This mod introduces a series of parasite-themed knives, including the Ashen Knife, Mortis Knife, Living Knife, Sentient Knife, Consumed Knife, and Hijacked Iron Knife.

A variety of new food items are added, making use of parasite-themed ingredients and expanding the cooking system. These include cooked shrimp, fried pig brain, fishlin stew, grilled fishlin, stuffed assimilated pumpkin, and cookies made from thornshade berries and deadblood. The mod also adds new ingredients such as shrimp shells, pig brain slices, and disco rice in several variants.

New utility items are included, such as the Consumed Bowl and Infested Bowl for serving meals, and Buglin Cocoon Powder as a crafting material.

For players who enjoy exploring the culinary side of parasite-infested worlds, Parasites' Delights provides a natural extension to both farming and survival gameplay.
